scores.evidence: There are 3 objectives, and each is still assessed (o1: q0–q2, e1, e2; o2: q3, e3, e4; o3: q4, e5, e6). The rebalanced e3 and e5 now discriminate and no longer give their answers away. The writing in o2 (「書ける」) and the design in o3 (「設計できる」) are still produced only in the practice sections, which have self-checks (p1-checklist, p2-checklist). The exam only asks the learner to select.

hook-b1 is a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「機能の実装を任せている途中で、急ぎのバグ修正を頼まれました…「毎晩、テストの失敗を報告してほしい」」) that sets up both halves of the lesson. The ungraded predict q0 targets the same-folder misconception, every wrong option has feedback, and the answer is the third option.

The prerequisites list 第2回, 第4回, 第6回, 第7回 and 第8回 plus Git basics. The text recalls them where they are used (「第7回の[[サブエージェント]]」, 「Manualモード（第2回）」, 「MCPサーバー（第8回）」). Terms are defined before use: s1-defs and s4-defs, 非対話的実行 in s3-lead, and glosses for トークン（token…）, シェル（shell…）, CI（継続的インテグレーション）, PR（プルリクエスト） and API（Application Programming Interface）. The glossary entries match s1-defs and s4-defs.

measure.mjs reports 「prose 2265 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2653 · practice reading 1246 · questions 11 · practice sections 2 · est 20.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, so the lesson is within budget but exactly at the cap. lint --strict reports 0 warnings. headless is dense: 非対話的実行, シェル and four new flags (s3-table) in one segment. unattended-where adds 2 terms that are never practiced.

Each practice task comes after a worked example. s2-code with s2-steps gives 5 subgoal-labelled steps, each with its reason (「消すと、ブランチごと消えます」). s3-code with s3-table explains each flag (「付けないと…」), and s4-prompt maps a model prompt to the 4 points in its expect. No faded example comes between these and practice; p1-model is almost the same as s3-code.

Four of the five segments end with an inline check that applies the idea to a new case: q1 (login text vs payment config), q2 (「モジュールが見つからない」), q3 (bare `-p` in CI) and q4 (5 quiet days). Each has a hint and per-option feedback. The exam items can no longer be solved by convergence: in e3 and e5 every flag or clause appears in exactly 2 options, so the learner must apply the flags and the 4 points.

The 7 misconceptions in the brief are still covered: broad `Bash` and `bypassPermissions` (e3 b, d: 「`Bash` は全コマンドを通し、`bypassPermissions` は確認を飛ばします。」), a missing `--bare` (e3 c, d), and a quiet day vs a failed read (q4 d, e5 b 「読めない日も「更新なし」になります」, e5 d). The rewritten feedback is one sentence each, but it now names what is wrong without the corrective next step the earlier version gave. The explanation supplies that step.

There are no images and no decoration. The comparisons in s1-table, s3-table and s4-table are 「〜なら、…」 lists, a defensible choice for mobile. The worktree layout (main folder, `.claude/worktrees/<名前>/`, branch `worktree-<名前>`) is spatial and is described only in text (ex-feature expect); a small diagram would help.

Both tasks are hands-on, with expect, a hint → troubleshoot ladder, a model answer (p1-model, p2-prompt expect) and a checklist (7 and 4 items). p-run also asks for a prediction first. The second task is not a transfer task: p2-before is the same nightly-test scenario as practice 1, and its model answer repeats p1-model's prompt.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam and matches the four key ideas. summary-next gives a reflection task (「成功の条件を1文で書いてみましょう」) and the next lesson. There are 7 retrieval flashcards, and summary-ask offers 3 askTutor suggestions.

The new e3 feedback repeats claims the lesson already cites and the earlier text made: without `--bare`, `-p` runs hooks and `.mcp.json` servers (e4 explanation), `bypassPermissions` skips prompts, and a bare `Bash` allows every shell command (s3-pitfall). check-quiz still cites cc-headless, cc-permission-modes and cc-permissions. The section title 「並列の3つの方法」 still counts methods, which the docs do not support (niceToHave).

The changed text keeps です・ます and a neutral tone. q4 d now uses 「新しい課題はありません」 for a quote that is not nested, and e5 b correctly keeps 『更新なし』 nested inside 「…」. The terminology split from the last round is unchanged: 「承認が要る」 in s3-mode and q3 vs 「確認が要る」 in s3-table, e3 and pc-mode, and 「練習用リポジトリ」 in s2-code vs 「練習用フォルダー」 in p1-task.

The only declared locale (jp) is complete, and no text is baked into images. The link text is descriptive (「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」), and the plain-text fields (checklist labels, askTutor) contain no markdown.

niceToHave: check-quiz e3/e5: the rewritten feedback now only diagnoses. To give the corrective step back where sentence length allows, e3 b could read 「`Bash` は全コマンドを通し、`bypassPermissions` は確認を飛ばします。`Bash(npm test *)` と `dontAsk` に絞ります。」 (the ja-editor decides the wording; keep each feedback to 2 sentences or fewer).
Still open from the last round, unchanged content: the section title 「1. 並列の3つの方法を選び分ける」 conflicts with s1-lead 「並列の作業を助ける道具を2つ紹介します」. Suggest 「1. 作業に合わせて並べ方を選ぶ」.

Still open: p2-before reuses the nightly-test task from practice 1, so it is not a transfer task. Consider a log-summary task (「毎朝ログを見て、エラーをいい感じにまとめておいて。原因がわかったら直しておいて。」) and update the model in the p2-prompt expect to match.
Still open: the p2-prompt variable should be 「直した依頼文とコマンド」 so Claude can check `--max-budget-usd` and the permission flags.
Still open: s3-code line 2 → `  "npm run lint の警告を数えてください。" \`; q3 option a → 「`npm test` が実行されないまま終わり、テスト結果のない要約が返る」.
Still open: unattended-where (s4-table) is neither assessed nor practiced. Add one inline item or shorten it to one sentence.
Still open: a 4–5 node worktree diagram with caption and alt would support s2-steps.
Load is still at the cap (measure.mjs est 20.0, estMinutes 20). Any addition needs a matching cut.
